relationships.statement: Measurement produces a value reasonably attributable to a quantitative property.
Measurement involves direct or indirect comparison with a standard.
A certified 32768 Hz quartz crystal resonator is given as an example of a standard.
A primary gas mixture is given as an example of a standard.
The phenomenon of interest interacts with a measuring instrument.
The body of interest interacts with a measuring instrument.
The substance of interest interacts with a measuring instrument.
A measuring instrument produces an indication responsive to the property of interest.
Measurement uncertainty is defined as a parameter associated with a measurement result and characterizing dispersion.
Standard measurement uncertainty is measurement uncertainty expressed as a standard deviation.
A scalar measurand is a measurand whose property of interest can be quantified by a single real number.
For scalar measurands, standard deviation is described as a parameter that may express measurement uncertainty.
